judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought to challenge the Development Certificate and approved Building Plan issued by the 1st Respondent to the 7 th Respondent, who is the owner of the land and developer, on the basis that the said certificates are violative of the regulations promulgated under the Urban Development Authority Law; Preliminary objection that the certificates had already lapsed and continued interim stay order had halted constructions, therefore, application was merely academic. Held – Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
